review.images: Reviewed six official gallery images and the wide hero. Omitted the narrower repeated garden shot. The townhouse street elevation supplies the listing card, with living and bedroom views in the editorial panels.
review.location: Matched the exact Greenway project pin and Emaar South regional map. Visually verified five travel figures on physical brochure page 5.
review.floorPlans: Viewed all ten physical pages, including the Classic and Modern cover pages. Transcribed eight image-only sheets, TH01 to TH04 for each design, and checked suite, garage and balcony or terrace sums. Retained the published 0.01 or 0.02 sq ft differences.

unavailable: Signed plot-specific areas and entrance coordinates were not verified.
